draft_audit.secondary_cost_metric: client_rpc_ms_per_executed_action = sum(complete client RPC ms) / executed actions
draft_audit.latency_warning: Mean request latency alone is not actual acceleration; GPU-stage model timing is not end-to-end. Report successful episodes and real episode wall alongside service costs.
draft_audit.prepared_costs: per-run result.json preparation_seconds; first request costs additionally in episode wall

vlm_fixed_input_cost.scope: Fixed-input inference cost only; small differences remain uncertain; no acceptance/quality/closed-loop speed claim

vlm_supplementary_goal.classification: Supplementary analysis registered after discovery and before any independent validation observation; original primary analysis remains unchanged
vlm_supplementary_goal.reporting: Report all three contrasts, outcomes and uncertainty, including any failure of the original primary pair. Provide exact paired one-sided p and Holm over all three, paired-case and task-cluster intervals, and per-task/per-init effects. Do not select a new direction from heldout results.
vlm_supplementary_goal.interpretation: Distinguish original Spatial/Long claim from prospective supplementary Goal/Long claim. Both can be unsupported; no positive claim from discovery alone.
vlm_supplementary_goal.reason: The original max-min rule tied at10pp and chose Spatial lexically. Goal showed30pp at discovery; adding it now uses the already planned Goal validation cases without hiding the original primary comparison.

reporting_bounds: All independent confirmation outcomes remain pending or incomplete; do not reselect from interim outcomes.
Complete target-fixed comparisons only; Long matched pure 2/6 is incomplete, not ranked against 10-case conditions.
First-input/noise metadata matches do not imply all first target actions passed tolerance.
Policy and RPC cost numerators include zero-action rejection requests; not steady-state exclusive-GPU speed.

实测成本并不随接受率单调变化，匹配来源也并非每个目标里最便宜：固定 Object 目标，匹配来源为23.12ms/action，Goal来源为21.02ms/action，双方均10/10成功，但接受率分别为61.37%与0%。这些发现支持 draft 来源依赖与 Full 回退掩盖质量损失；尚不能把实测成本差全部因果归于泛化下降，也不能声称原本存在的加速收益被跨suite切换消除，因为匹配FLASH条件本身也慢于同目标Full。冷启动、任务轨迹和同卡争用等仍限制解释，现有数据未识别具体主因。

当前训练/serving代码共享 base assets/physical-intelligence/libero 的归一化合同，未发现source专属变换或实际mismatch；但发布head缺少原训练checkpoint、norm hash及config快照，原cache也缺失，因此本轮只能说明固定共同推理合同下的发布head迁移表现，不能称已完全排除历史预处理混淆。teacher_zero_noise仅指训练缓存，官方online默认同样使用标准正态噪声；本轮显式NumPy case/replan配对高斯并非新增zero-vs-random错配，但RNG及CPU→GPU路径不同，不能称官方默认数值或时延的精确复现。policy_wall_ms只包围native original_infer，CPU种子生成和输入hash在计时外；完整client RPC包含wrapper与传输，故分别标为native-policy成本与完整RPC成本，指标值不变。
